title: eubotryoides tschonoskii

It is used in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues, with its reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eubotryoides tschonoskii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, that have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcer properties.
